name: rebuilt

shots.onScreen: black. One word at a time in a sans, answered by a word in a SERIF ITALIC, with a small blue dot as the joint between them. A late line arrives huge and mixed-weight over a bloom of light, then the ground closes back to black.
shots.moves: The type does not travel: it ACCUMULATES, word by word, on a held frame. The move is the GROUND blooming from black to a bright wash under the last line and closing again.
shots.trigger: The bloom collapses and the frame is black. A hard cut lands on the light shot.

shots.onScreen: A single small UI chip on near-white, a label typing in beside a mark. Almost nothing else in frame.
shots.moves: One word types. Measured motion 6.74 on a 1.17s shot, so it is dense rather than held: the shot is short and the typing fills it.
shots.trigger: Hard cut. It is the shortest shot in the film by 3x and reads as a beat of punctuation, not a scene.

shots.onScreen: A dark GRID. Cells of photography, icons, currency and two huge sans words sliding through the cells. Dotted rules mark the grid. The busiest frame in the film (motion 5.77).
shots.moves: The grid TRAVELS as one object while individual cells carry their own content. Words cross cell boundaries, which is what makes it read as one surface rather than a collage.
shots.trigger: Hard cut to white. The inversion is the transition.

shots.onScreen: Near-white. A giant blue word blows through the frame far larger than the canvas, motion-blurred, then resolves to a small blue line of type, then the payoff line in mixed sans + serif italic with a hairline rule and a tiny annotation.
shots.moves: Scale contrast IS the move: one word at roughly 8x the frame's type size crossing it, then everything after it small and still. The blue dot returns as the annotation's bullet.
shots.trigger: Hard cut to dark on the payoff line's last frame.

shots.onScreen: Dark. Dimensional cards tumbling, small app tiles drifting at different distances, a wordmark scrambling into place, then the mark alone, then black.
shots.moves: Objects at visibly DIFFERENT DEPTHS: the cards turn in space while the tiles drift slowly behind them. The letters of the wordmark settle from scattered positions.
shots.trigger: Nothing: it is the last shot. It ends by fading the ground to black under a held mark, 11s, the longest shot in the film.

threads: A BLUE DOT. It is the joint between two words in shot 1, the seed the light grows from, and the bullet on the annotation in shot 4. It survives every cut and every ground inversion, and it is the smallest object in the film.
spectacle: Shot 4: one word at roughly eight times the frame's own type size crossing the whole canvas motion-blurred. It is loud because every other shot is restrained, and it lasts under a second.
takeaway: THE GROUND INVERTS ON EVERY CUT: dark 39 / light 234 / dark 31 / light 228 / dark 36. That is not a flourish, it is the film's transition mechanism, and it means no cut needs an effect on it. Second: a SANS + SERIF-ITALIC pairing carries the entire typographic identity, used at every scale from a 20px annotation to a frame-crossing word. Third: the film's motion runs 3.0 to 7.6 and our most active film measures 1.78, so it is 2x to 4x more active than anything in our library.
